svg.title: GPU update paths and command buffer retirement
svg.desc: Two connected panels preserve the complete source graph. Panel A shows asset, descriptor and batch inputs joining at the command buffer. Panel B shows picking and render-target branches joining at that same command buffer before GPU completion and safe retirement.
svg.text: A. Asset, shader and batch inputs
B. Scene, target and completion path

text.tspan: The command buffer in panel B is the same submission
Together, the panels follow updates to the final buffer
through GPU completion and safe retirement.
